schema.game: Ocarina of Time (Switch 2 remake), v131072, build e0f3ccfa

tabs.title: Overview
tabs.caveat: Life and MaxLife are quarter-hearts (12 = three hearts). Sequence_IsLoadingBanc is runtime-only and is not in progress.sav.

groups.title: Headline scalars
groups.description: The small set of exact-name values the overview shows first.
groups.caveat: MaxLife is capacity, not a current value. There is no stored wallet maximum.
matchRules: exact verified on-disk names only; no prefix or pattern match

tabs.title: Player & World
tabs.caveat: PlayerStatus.CurrentPos, PlayerStatus.CurrentDir, and Sequence_IsLoadingBanc are runtime-only (SaveFileIndex -1) and are not editable. No dedicated saved spawn/entrance or camera scalar has a verified name.

groups.title: Position and rotation
groups.description: The saved map position and facing used by the host bridge.

groups.title: Scene, age, and room
groups.description: Current banc/scene string, the child/adult flag, and the last saved dungeon room.
groups.caveat: Sequence_IsChildhood is the only stored age signal; there is no Age integer.

groups.title: Map markers and warp points
groups.description: Map-icon anchors and the two saved warp-point records.
groups.caveat: These are saved map-marker values, not a spawn-point catalogue.

tabs.title: Inventory
tabs.caveat: Only three stock/count values have verified names: gold tokens, magic beans, and giant-sword life. Per-item ammo counts and pouch contents other than bottles have no verified names. IsGet.* entries are acquisition flags, not counts.

groups.title: Acquired items, weapons, armor, and pouch
groups.description: Every verified IsGet item/weapon/armor/pouch acquisition flag.

groups.title: Pouch assignment and stock
groups.description: Assignable-item enum for the current era plus the only named PouchData stock counter.
matchRules: bottle fields are shown in inventory.bottles instead

groups.title: Bottles
groups.description: All five bottle contents and their IsValid flags. The five BottleItem fields share one 13-member enum table.

groups.title: Ammo, capacity, and counts
groups.description: Verified quiver/bullet-bag/bomb-bag/scale/pouch acquisition flags plus the two named integer counts.
groups.caveat: No arrow, bomb, deku-stick, or deku-nut count field exists. These are upgrade/acquisition flags.
matchRules: excludes ^IsGet\. (already inventory.acquisition) and ^ActionGuide_IsEnd\. (guide UI, not item state)

tabs.title: Equipment
tabs.caveat: Equipment slots are String64 asset/id text, not numeric item ids. No verified gauntlet field exists. PlayerStatus.IsActiveGlassTruth is runtime-only and is excluded.

groups.title: Equipped slots
groups.description: The seven equipment strings plus the two alternative-era slots.

groups.title: Weapon and armor acquisition
groups.description: Verified IsGet weapon/shield/armor flags for equipment the player has obtained.

groups.title: Equipment state
groups.description: Active head armor, agony-stone equip, defense boost, and giant sword life.
groups.caveat: No equipment-slot enum exists; slots are strings.

tabs.title: Resources
tabs.caveat: No MaxRupee, wallet level, or rupee-capacity field exists. CurrentRupee is stored without a verified maximum. Ammo fields are acquisition/upgrade flags, not counts.

groups.title: Health
groups.description: Current and maximum life, plus the defense upgrade.
groups.caveat: Life values are quarter-hearts; 12 is three hearts.

groups.title: Magic
groups.description: Current and maximum MP plus the two magic-capacity blessings.

groups.title: Rupees
groups.description: The stored rupee count. No capacity field is known.
groups.caveat: Do not clamp this value to an invented wallet maximum; no MaxRupee field exists.

groups.title: Stored counts
groups.description: The named integer counts that are not health, magic, or rupees.
groups.caveat: No generic inventory count table is named in the schema.

groups.title: Capacity upgrades
groups.description: Verified quiver, bullet-bag, bomb-bag, and scale upgrade flags.

tabs.title: Progression
tabs.caveat: There is no medallion bitmask and no single song mask. Stone and sage progress is spread across individual flags; the 164 HavePlayedEvent flags mix cutscene/room state with quest state.

groups.title: Played events
groups.description: Every verified HavePlayedEvent flag.
groups.caveat: This includes room, cutscene, and hint state, not only quest progress.

groups.title: Get_* progress
groups.description: Every verified Get_* flag or count.

groups.title: IsGet.* progress
groups.description: Every verified IsGet flag, including item and equipment acquisition also shown in their own tabs.

groups.title: Sages and great fairies
groups.description: AllSage counters plus verified SageOf/Step_SageOf and Meet_GreatFairy flags.
groups.caveat: AllSage_AwakeSageCount is a count; the rest are individual flags.

groups.title: Spiritual stones
groups.description: Verified stone-quest flags for Forest, Fire, and Water plus the Door of Time stone count.
groups.caveat: Includes dialogue and completion flags; there is no single stone bitmask.

groups.title: Door of Time
groups.description: Every verified DoorOfTime_* field.

groups.title: Songs and melodies
groups.description: Verified melody acquisition and melody-get flags. The source spelling Spilit is the Spirit melody.
groups.caveat: There is no single songs-learned bitmask; these are individual flags.

groups.title: Medallions
groups.description: Reserved for medallion fields. None have a verified name in this revision.
groups.caveat: No field containing Medallion has a verified name. Absence is not proof that the concept is absent from the save.

tabs.title: Dungeons
tabs.caveat: Only three dungeons have named DungeonInfo.* item flags (five fields). Small keys are per-room flags. DungeonInfo.*.BossRetryNum is runtime-only. Only one heart-container flag is named.

groups.title: DodongoCavern items
groups.description: Named DungeonInfo.DodongoCavern item flags: map, compass, boss key, and any other verified member.
groups.caveat: Only named DungeonInfo members are shown; BossRetryNum is runtime-only.

groups.title: FireTemple items
groups.description: Named DungeonInfo.FireTemple item flags: map, compass, boss key, and any other verified member.
groups.caveat: Only named DungeonInfo members are shown; BossRetryNum is runtime-only.

groups.title: WaterTemple items
groups.description: Named DungeonInfo.WaterTemple item flags: map, compass, boss key, and any other verified member.
groups.caveat: Only named DungeonInfo members are shown; BossRetryNum is runtime-only.

groups.title: Small keys
groups.description: Every verified per-room small-key flag, including the four Gerudo Fortress keys.
groups.caveat: There is no single small-key inventory count; keys are per-room flags.

groups.title: Boss defeat flags
groups.description: Verified DefeatBoss/BossOut flags, including the final battle.

groups.title: Map items
groups.description: Verified dungeon-map and map-icon flags outside DungeonInfo.
groups.caveat: DungeonInfo.*.IsGetMap is shown in its per-dungeon group.

groups.title: Heart containers
groups.description: Verified *_Heart_Container_Obtained flags. Only one is named.
groups.caveat: Heart pieces are in collectibles; only boss heart containers belong here.

tabs.title: Collectibles
tabs.caveat: No Gold Skulltula count field exists; only PouchData.Item_Token_Gold.StockNum and token event flags are named. Fishing sizes and best times are real numeric records.

groups.title: Gold Skulltula tokens
groups.description: The token stock counter plus verified GatheringTokenGold, HaveEncountered_Token, and token-counter flags.
groups.caveat: No total Gold Skulltula count field exists; token stock is the closest stored count.

groups.title: Heart pieces
groups.description: Verified HeartPiece/Heart_Piece flags. Boss heart containers are in dungeons.

groups.title: Magic beans
groups.description: Get_MagicBeans count plus verified MagicBean soil and hint flags.
groups.caveat: Get_MagicBeans is the count; the soil flags record planted locations.

groups.title: Poes and Big Poes
groups.description: Verified Big Poe defeats, Guide Poe progress, and Poe bottle flags.
groups.caveat: No Big Poe count field exists; the ten Hyrule Field defeats are individual flags.

groups.title: Fishing
groups.description: Every verified Fishing field, including records.
groups.caveat: Includes tutorial, weather, and pond-state flags, not only records.

groups.title: High scores and best times
groups.description: Verified BestScore/NewScore/BestTime and record flags.
groups.caveat: Some rows also appear in collectibles.fishing; group counts are memberships, not a partition.

tabs.title: Flags
tabs.caveat: 10,212 Bool fields: 3,443 named, 6,769 hash-only. Buckets are counts; use the query API (flagBuckets/flagFieldsUnder) instead of rendering 10k rows inline.

groups.title: Boolean flags by prefix
groups.description: All named Bool fields, bucketed by the first dot or underscore prefix, plus the hash-only Bool count.
matchRules: bucket prefix = first '.' segment, else first '_' segment, else (other)
unnamed Bool fields are counted, never named

tabs.title: Advanced
tabs.caveat: 8,317 of 11,925 on-disk fields have no recovered name. Seven opaque Binary/BinaryArray/WString16Array records are listed by hash only. Changing a Binary length requires rebuilding the tail and pointers.

groups.title: Hash-only and opaque fields
groups.description: Counts of unnamed fields by wire type plus every opaque Binary/BinaryArray/WString16Array hash.
matchRules: type counts over all on-disk fields with name == null
opaque hashes: type in Binary, BinaryArray, WString16Array
no fabricated labels; opaque entries carry hash and type only

tabs.title: Settings
tabs.caveat: No progress.sav fields. App settings are not modelled by this schema; option.sav is declared in the container map but its fields were not extracted.

groups.title: Application settings
groups.description: Empty by design: this tab edits application preferences, not save fields.
groups.caveat: option.sav has no extracted fields in this schema. Do not invent settings keys.
matchRules: no progress.sav field maps to app settings
